title: Dependency graph of the verified Balancer V2 repair
rule: Nodes are the declarations reached from the eight requirement theorems by following the constants each declaration's type and value use, as the Lean kernel sees them, restricted to the repair (final.lean) and the locked specification. Compiler-generated declarations are walked through, so their uses count for the declaration that generated them; constructors, recursors and projections count as their type; Lean's core library is not shown. A declaration of the repair that no requirement uses is left out and listed under excluded. An edge [a, b] means a uses b.
